code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Blood Sampling for PK/PD
data.description: Repeated blood draws for pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic analysis including plasma total molybdenum, PUF-molybdenum, plasma total and PUF copper, labile bound copper, ceruloplasmin, and ceruloplasmin-bound copper.

name.quote: Participants will undergo repeated blood draws to measure the PK of the study intervention and metabolism.

label.quote: Blood sampling for PK: Plasma total Mo and PUF-Mo

description.quote: Blood sampling for PK: Plasma total Mo and PUF-Mo PD: Plasma total and PUF-Cu, LBC, ceruloplasmin, ceruloplasmin-bound Cu

data.name: 24-Hour Urine Collection

code.decode: Volume measurement for timed collection, each

data.label: 24-hour urine for Cu and Mo
data.description: 24-hour urine collection pooled for analysis of copper and molybdenum concentration by ICP-MS; volumes recorded for each collection period.

name.quote: Urine samples to measure copper and molybdenum content will be collected periodically as described in the SoA (Table 1).

description.quote: For each 24-hour collection period, urine will be pooled for analysis and volumes will be recorded.

data.name: Fecal Sample Collection
data.label: Feces for Cu and Mo
data.description: Individual fecal samples collected, weighed, and stored; weight and time of each bowel movement recorded; copper and molybdenum concentration determined by ICP-MS using minimum technical triplicates.

name.quote: Fecal samples to measure copper and molybdenum content will be collected periodically as described in the SoA (Table 1).

description.quote: Fecal samples will be individually collected, weighed, and stored. The weight and time of each bowel movement will be recorded.

data.name: Physical Examination

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient, moderate complexity

data.label: Physical Examination
data.description: Complete physical examination including cardiovascular, respiratory, gastrointestinal, and neurological systems; height and weight also measured and recorded.

name.quote: A complete physical examination will include, at a minimum, assessments of the cardiovascular, respiratory, gastrointestinal, and neurological systems.

description.quote: A complete physical examination will include, at a minimum, assessments of the cardiovascular, respiratory, gastrointestinal, and neurological systems. Height (at Screening only) and weight (as per the SoA for physical examinations) will also be measured and recorded.

data.name: Vital Signs Measurement

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, minimal complexity

data.label: Vital Signs
data.description: Assessment of body temperature, heart rate, respiratory rate, and systolic and diastolic blood pressure using consistent methods and equipment; blood pressure and heart rate measured with a completely automated device.

name.quote: Body temperature, heart rate, respiratory rate, and systolic and diastolic blood pressure (mm Hg) will be assessed using consistent methods and equipment to allow comparability and reproducibility throughout the study.

description.quote: Blood pressure and heart rate measurements will be assessed with a completely automated device. Manual techniques will be used only if an automated device is not available.
